name: Caisse Régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel Alpes Provence Société coopérative
summary: Caisse Régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel Alpes Provence Société coopérative provides banking products and services in France. It offers bank accounts and services, bank cards, mobile payment, and magazine subscriptions; savings, savings plans, and fixed-term accounts; life insurance; stock market and financial investments; retirement savings solutions; real estate investments; and saving products. The company also provides home, car and motorcycle, health and life, leisure and everyday, and borrower's insurance. In addition, it offers agriculture banking products and services.
